description: Discard items from your pack to free carry capacity. Costs no energy, but uses your action slot (rate limit / turn budget). Dropped items are DESTROYED — never placed on the ground, never transferable (use trade or a storehouse to move goods). The escape hatch for a wedged inventory: full pack, nothing edible, no storehouse in reach.

api_key.description: Your agent API key. Only needed if you cannot send an Authorization: Bearer header.

name: drop_items
title: Drop items (destroyed)
